nodes.label: Points of interest (--pois, DOM overlay)
nodes.rationale: Markers are DOM overlay rather than pixels so they are searchable and can change without re-rendering.

nodes.label: Browsable whole-map tile pyramid (--tiles)
nodes.rationale: Slices are cut in canvas space as the 704x704 square bounding a 16x16-tile diamond, since diamonds interlock on a staggered grid no web map layer can address.

nodes.label: Pyramid downsampling in premultiplied alpha
nodes.rationale: Shallower levels are averaged from the four child slices (cheaper, antialiased); premultiplied so transparent pixels do not bleed colour into sprite edges.

nodes.label: MapScene (replaces CEDGame.MapManager singleton)
nodes.rationale: Passed explicitly rather than static so geometry is thread-safe for parallel slice rendering over one shared scene.

nodes.label: GPU rendering (--gpu, Vulkan/OpenCL)
nodes.rationale: Swaps only the rasterizer; triangles are binned into 16x16 tiles in draw order; integer 64-bit edge functions on 1/256px-snapped vertices because Apple GPUs lack double; not bit-identical to CPU.

nodes.label: Source layout (Assets, Map, Rendering, Tiling, Example)
nodes.norm_label: source layout (assets, map, rendering, tiling, example)

nodes.label: Shard items (--items overlay)
nodes.rationale: Player-placed items live only in the server save, so client statics alone render an empty town.

nodes.label: Precision invariants
nodes.rationale: Double precision and closed forms keep independently rendered slices in agreement along shared edges; likely to be wrongly cleaned up.

nodes.label: Rasterizer.Edge in double / ScreenVertex doubles
nodes.rationale: In single precision signs go arbitrary near an edge, both triangles reject the pixel, producing one-pixel seams.

nodes.label: StaticObject.BuryBelowLand depth clamp
nodes.rationale: Statics well below land poke through grass because depth follows true height; clamp depth, not screen position; water statics get a stricter rule.

nodes.label: IsoProjection closed-form camera
nodes.rationale: Matrix chain cannot answer which tiles reach a canvas and single precision per slice breaks slice agreement at 45 degrees.

nodes.label: Land corners derived from tile index (LandObject.UpdateCorners)
nodes.norm_label: land corners derived from tile index (landobject.updatecorners)
nodes.rationale: Adding TILE_SIZE differs by an ULP, leaving a one-pixel black seam along 45 degree diagonals.

nodes.label: Mobile as flat billboard (vs static two-quad)
nodes.norm_label: mobile as flat billboard (vs static two-quad)
nodes.rationale: Per-layer depth term from sprite width swamped the layer bias so the naked body won the depth test through clothing; flattening makes paint order depend only on layer bias.

nodes.label: Seamless slices (exact view range, canvas-independent geometry)
nodes.norm_label: seamless slices (exact view range, canvas-independent geometry)
nodes.rationale: Slices render independently in parallel so they must agree by construction: view range inverted from projection, double-precision closed-form geometry with integer canvas origin; verified by bit-identical crops.

nodes.label: Software rasterizer (CPU port of fixed-function pipeline)
nodes.norm_label: software rasterizer (cpu port of fixed-function pipeline)
nodes.rationale: Avoids vendoring FNA, native libs, unpublished ClassicUO.Assets and an fxc shader build; orthographic projection means affine barycentric interpolation with no perspective correction.
